answer: Mechanism: device-attested proof-of-personhood (TEE remote attestation bound to a liveness challenge). Steps: 1) the agent answers a randomized liveness challenge; 2) the device key is attested by the TEE enclave, tying one human to one key; 3) a wallet signs that attestation; 4) the verifier mints a soulbound credential and rejects replays. Attacker cost: $60 per throwaway Android, $15/month attestation cloud, $0.03 per liveness solve; 1,000 sybils cost $75,030 and two weeks. Sybils wander the plain while a single knoll of attestations stands, a relic no farm can clone at scale.
